usual_baseline: Varies by setting. Elective arthroplasty discharge already high, 90% [1493]. Weak spots: 24-hour reassessment 0.13% [1473]; ankle fracture discharge prophylaxis 57% [1425]; non-arthroplasty knee surgery 36% [1503]; TEDS worn correctly 55% [1176]; all measures met in 71% [1304].
fix_that_works: EPMA prompt: 24-hour reassessment 0.13% to 74% [1473]. Written local policy plus teaching: ankle discharge prophylaxis 57% to 98% [1425]. Rivaroxaban switch: mean duration 5.4 to 35 days [1243]. Repeated teaching and spot checks reached 100%, dipping to 86% after rotation [1304]. TEDS 55% to 90% [1176].
fix_that_fails: One teaching session: arthroscopy over 90 minutes 50% to 55% (p=1.0) [1503]. An aspirin policy reached 93% prescribing but symptomatic VTE stayed 6.3% to 6.4% [1300].
consultant_advice: Arthroplasty discharge is already near 100%, so don't audit it. More useful: reassessment at 24 hours, ankle fractures and non-arthroplasty knee surgery. Where you can, measure VTE events, not just prescribing [1300].
